descriptions.vocabulary_in_context: Inferring word or idiom meaning from paragraph and discourse cues.
descriptions.grammar_in_context: Testing sentence structure, tense shifts, voice, and connective syntax.
descriptions.explicit_detail: Locating and confirming factual propositions directly stated in the text.
descriptions.reference_resolution: Identifying pronoun or phrase referents across clauses or paragraphs.
descriptions.local_inference: Synthesizing unstated facts from adjacent sentences.
descriptions.cross_sentence_inference: Integrating clues across distant paragraphs or narrative arcs.
descriptions.main_idea: Abstracting the overall theme, gist, communicative goal, or optimal title.
descriptions.purpose_speaker_intent: Analyzing why the author/speaker included a detail or adopted a tone.
descriptions.discourse_relationship: Evaluating logical connectors and transitions between clauses.
descriptions.sequence_cause_consequence: Reconstructing event timelines or cause-and-effect chains.
descriptions.text_structure: Analyzing paragraph organization and structural roles in the reading.
descriptions.information_integration: Reconciling multi-modal data from tables, diagrams, maps, or charts.
descriptions.pragmatic_meaning: Interpreting communicative implicature and social dialogue intentions.
descriptions.other_uncertain: Unclassified question designs requiring custom explanation.
